title: Stochastic deduplicated optional editor campaign
review_inclusion: Self-match each optional final output against its exact pre-editor candidate. Count normalized-identical outputs as automatic ties. Content-hash normalized unordered changed pairs and include exactly one representative of each unique pair in blinded review.
multiplicity_policy: Preserve duplicate changed-trial multiplicity as aggregate telemetry but never present duplicates as independent human-review items or independent inferential samples.
decision_boundary: Inspect diversity before review intake. Do not open a chamber whose unique changed-pair count is too small to justify operator review, and do not promote optional editing from a conditional subset alone.
